name: monitor_create
summary: Watch a search on a listings site (willhaben, ImmoScout24, eBay, Kleinanzeigen, Amazon, any results page) on a schedule and alert the user whenever a NEW listing appears. Use for 'tell me when…', 'let me know if a new … shows up', 'check … every hour/day', 'monitor/watch …'. The first run stores what is there now.

args.name: string: short label, e.g. 'Flats Wien ≤1200 €'
args.site: willhaben | immoscout_at | immoscout_de | ebay_de | ebay_at | kleinanzeigen | amazon_de | other
args.query: string: search words (things), or extra words for flats (e.g. 'balkon')
args.place: string: city for flats (Wien, Graz, Berlin, München…)
args.url: string: ONLY for site=other — that site's search URL with the filters, newest first
args.interval_min: int: minutes between checks (default 60; 15–30 for fast markets, 360 or 1440 for slow ones)
